ecg.baselineremove.ecg: Sampled ECG signal from which the slowly varying baseline will be removed.
ecg.baselineremove.fiducial_positions: Sample positions expected to represent a local isoelectric ECG level.
ecg.baselineremove.offset: Number of samples subtracted from every fiducial before estimating its local level.
ecg.baselineremove.window_size: Requested local averaging span around each adjusted fiducial.
ecg.baselineremove.ecg_detrended: ECG after subtracting the estimated baseline.
ecg.baselineremove.baseline: Estimated baseline aligned sample by sample with the input ECG.

ecg.pantompkins.ecg: Sampled ECG signal in which R waves will be detected.
ecg.pantompkins.sampling_frequency: Sampling frequency of the ECG signal.
ecg.pantompkins.bandpass_frequency: Lower and upper cutoff frequencies of the detection band-pass filter.
ecg.pantompkins.integration_window_size: Duration of the moving integration window used by the detector.
ecg.pantompkins.minimum_peak_distance: Minimum accepted temporal separation between candidate R waves.
ecg.pantompkins.snap_to_peak_window_size: Local search radius used to refine each detection on the ECG.
ecg.pantompkins.r_wave_times: Detected R-wave occurrence times in ascending order.
ecg.pantompkins.ecg_filtered: Band-pass-filtered ECG used by the detection chain.
ecg.pantompkins.decg_squared: Squared derivative signal used to emphasize rapid QRS changes.
ecg.pantompkins.decg_envelope: Integrated detection envelope used to locate candidate beats.

ecg.sloperange.r_wave_times: R-wave occurrence times aligned with the derivative ECG.
ecg.sloperange.sampling_frequency: Sampling frequency of the derivative ECG.
ecg.sloperange.upslopes: Signal-aligned local upslope traces used for inspection.
ecg.sloperange.downslopes: Signal-aligned local downslope traces used for inspection.
ecg.sloperange.upslope_max_positions: Selected maximum-upslope position for each processed beat.
ecg.sloperange.downslope_min_positions: Selected minimum-downslope position for each processed beat.

hrv.fdmetrics.pxx: Power spectral density used by the conventional LF/HF mode.
hrv.fdmetrics.related_pxx: Spectrum of the HRV component linearly related to respiration.
hrv.fdmetrics.unrelated_pxx: Spectrum of the residual HRV component not represented by respiration.
hrv.fdmetrics.f: Strictly increasing frequency grid shared by the supplied spectrum or spectra.
hrv.fdmetrics.limit_hf: Whether conventional HF integration stops at the represented 0.4 Hz boundary.
hrv.fdmetrics.lfn: Low-frequency power normalized by the combined LF and HF power.
hrv.fdmetrics.lfhf: Ratio between conventional low-frequency and high-frequency power.
hrv.fdmetrics.re: Respiration-related power over the represented analysis range.

hrv.fillgaps.tk: Strictly increasing event occurrence times after false-positive removal.
hrv.fillgaps.gap_detection_factor: Multiplier that marks an observed interval as locally long.
hrv.fillgaps.correction_upper_factor: Upper acceptance bound for reconstructed intervals.
hrv.fillgaps.correction_lower_factor: Lower acceptance bound used while choosing insertion counts.
hrv.fillgaps.max_gap_duration: Longest gap duration that the method will attempt to reconstruct.
hrv.fillgaps.tn: Event occurrence times including accepted reconstructed events.
hrv.fillgaps.dtn: Intervals between output events, with unresolved spans kept explicit.

hrv.ipfm.tn: Strictly increasing beat or pulse occurrence times.
hrv.ipfm.fs: Sampling frequency of the uniform output grid.
hrv.ipfm.spline_order: Order of the B-spline used to interpolate cumulative event count.
hrv.ipfm.m: Optional dimensionless TVIPFM modulation relative to the time-varying mean rate.

hrv.osp.m: Uniformly sampled HRV modulation signal to be decomposed.
hrv.osp.resp: Respiratory signal sampled on the same grid and time origin as the HRV modulation.
hrv.osp.resp_pxx: Respiratory power spectrum used to select a dominant respiratory frequency.
hrv.osp.f: Frequency grid associated with the respiratory spectrum.
hrv.osp.fs: Common sampling frequency of the HRV modulation and respiratory signals.
hrv.osp.min_resp_frequency: Lower bound applied to the selected respiratory frequency.
hrv.osp.m_resp: HRV component represented by the delayed-respiration subspace.
hrv.osp.m_unrelated: Residual HRV component outside the selected linear respiratory subspace.
hrv.osp.delay: Adaptive number of respiratory regressors and first aligned output sample.

hrv.removefp.tk: Strictly increasing event occurrence times that may contain false-positive detections.
hrv.removefp.tn: Event occurrence times after removing detections that follow abnormally short intervals.

hrv.tdmetrics.mhr: Mean heart or pulse rate computed from valid intervals.
hrv.tdmetrics.sdnn: Sample standard deviation of valid intervals.
hrv.tdmetrics.sdsd: Sample standard deviation of successive valid interval differences.
hrv.tdmetrics.rmssd: Root mean square of successive valid interval differences.
hrv.tdmetrics.pnn50: Percentage of successive valid interval differences greater than 50 ms.

tools.lpdfilter.sampling_frequency: Sampling frequency for which the differentiating filter is designed.
tools.lpdfilter.stop_frequency: Frequency at which the low-pass differentiating response reaches its stop band.
tools.lpdfilter.pass_frequency: Optional end of the differentiating pass band.
tools.lpdfilter.filter_coefficients: FIR numerator coefficients of the designed differentiating filter.
tools.lpdfilter.delay: Constant linear-phase delay introduced by the FIR filter.

tools.medfilt_threshold.x: One-dimensional signal for which an adaptive threshold is required.
tools.medfilt_threshold.factor: Multiplier applied to the local median baseline.
tools.medfilt_threshold.max_threshold: Upper cap applied to the adaptive threshold.

tools.nanfilter.numerator_coefficients: Numerator coefficients of the causal digital filter.
tools.nanfilter.denominator_coefficients: Denominator coefficients of the causal digital filter.
tools.nanfilter.signal: Signal to filter, optionally containing missing-value gaps.
tools.nanfilter.max_gap: Largest internal NaN gap that will be interpolated before filtering.
tools.nanfilter.filtered_signal: Causally filtered signal with long missing spans preserved.

tools.nanfiltfilt.numerator_coefficients: Numerator coefficients of the digital filter.
tools.nanfiltfilt.denominator_coefficients: Denominator coefficients of the digital filter.
tools.nanfiltfilt.signal: Signal to filter, optionally containing missing-value gaps.
tools.nanfiltfilt.max_gap: Largest internal NaN gap that will be interpolated before filtering.
tools.nanfiltfilt.filtered_signal: Zero-phase filtered signal with long missing spans preserved.

tools.snaptopeak.ecg: Sampled ECG signal used to refine candidate detections.
tools.snaptopeak.detections: Candidate sample positions to move onto nearby ECG maxima.
tools.snaptopeak.window_size: Search radius around each candidate detection.
tools.snaptopeak.refined_detections: Detection positions moved to the selected local ECG maxima.

tools.trimnans.signal: Signal whose leading and trailing missing samples will be removed.
tools.trimnans.trimmed_signal: Unchanged span from the first through the last finite sample, preserving internal gaps.

tools.expandnans.signal: Signal whose original missing spans will be expanded.
tools.expandnans.expansion_duration: Time margin applied on each side of every original missing span.
tools.expandnans.expanded_signal: Signal with enlarged missing spans, preserving length and sample alignment.

tools.interpgap.signal: Regularly sampled real signal with missing samples marked as NaN.
tools.interpgap.max_gap: Maximum number of consecutive missing samples to reconstruct.
tools.interpgap.method: Interpolation method: linear, nearest, pchip, or spline.
tools.interpgap.interpolated_signal: Signal with eligible gaps reconstructed, preserving original measurements and sample alignment.

tools.findsequences.signal: Real sample sequence; NaN and both signs of infinity are accepted.
tools.findsequences.start_positions: Inclusive start positions using the native index origin; shared cases use one-based positions.
tools.findsequences.end_positions: Inclusive end positions using the native index origin; shared cases use one-based positions.
tools.findsequences.lengths: Number of samples in each maximal repeated run.

tools.slicesignal.overlap: Number of samples shared by consecutive windows.
tools.slicesignal.sampling_frequency: Optional sampling frequency, required to calculate time centers.
tools.slicesignal.use_last: Include an uncovered final window with NaN padding.
tools.slicesignal.window_samples: Window samples in chronological window order, exposed as columns in MATLAB or rows in Python.
tools.slicesignal.time_centers: Nominal time center of each window, in seconds from the first sample.

tools.localmax.signal: Real vector or two-dimensional matrix of search signals.
tools.localmax.axis: Axis along which to search. By default, search the first non-singleton axis.
tools.localmax.peak_values: Highest local peak value per analyzed signal, or NaN.
tools.localmax.peak_positions: Original sample position per analyzed signal, using the language-native index origin, or NaN.

tools.hjorth.signal: Nonempty real signal vector, optionally with NaNs.
tools.hjorth.activity: Mean-square power of the input samples.
tools.hjorth.mobility: First-difference energy relative to signal energy, scaled to Hz.
tools.hjorth.complexity: Frequency-spread descriptor from first- and second-difference energy ratios.
